confidence_notes: One RBA search and one Cairo price search were done. Meal, coffee and beer figures come from cost-of-living aggregators (Expat Arrivals, MyLifeElsewhere, Traveltables) that disagree and partly date from 2023. Cocktail and wine prices were not found. They are estimated as a multiple of beer, with a premium because alcohol in Egypt is mostly served in hotels and tourist venues. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against listings. The RBA rate was the 18 November 2026 observation, which was later than the July 2026 pricing window. The Egyptian pound has been volatile.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Cairo aggregator prices, with a premium for tourist-oriented venues. Comparable to other lower-cost North African and Middle Eastern cities such as Amman and Marrakech.
